rows.basis: The company stated inspection revenue for HBM and heterogeneous packaging of advanced logic for AI applications was over $20M in the quarter ended 1 Jul 2023. This is one quarter only, so it is a floor for FY2023 AI revenue, not the full year. Share is 20.0M ÷ 815.9M FY2023 revenue.

MD&A attributes the 21% FY2024 revenue increase and the $167.1M rise in systems and software revenue mainly to Dragonfly inspection units for advanced packaging of AI chips. The quarterly figures ($229M, $242M and $252M total revenue, and $164M specialty and advanced packaging in Q2) are totals or lines broader than AI, so they are not AI amounts.
The Q2 2023 release anticipated significant growth over the next several quarters in inspection revenue for HBM and AI heterogeneous packaging. It gave no figure.

MD&A says systems and software revenue fell $2.6M in FY2025, mainly because fewer inspection units shipped for AI advanced packaging, partly offset by Advanced Nodes metrology and SiC. AI is named as a demand driver with no figure.
